string.text: Limb damage sticks to the bone that was hit. Falls split across both legs (or one random leg if only 1 point). Unknown bones split across arms+legs (random if too few points). Radiation/toxic whole-body hits (bone 65535) never damage limbs. Keeps ADB's last-hit head protection: the next hit after a head hit redirects to torso (not arms). Medik heal/UI unchanged. Always on while installed.
